review_scope: Inspect actual saved image pixels and hash, then compare source-specific gates and requester meaning. Root knows concepts and source design; review is not blinded.

decisions.source_contribution: Issued full source plus justified existing owners plus literal final prompt change; existing baseline ideas are not reattributed to source.
decisions.technical_native_approval: H-F2 authorship inspiration is not typed native approval.
decisions.causal_quality_gain: not_measured; no matched image baseline or repeated random-seed sampling

review_order: actual saved image before agent pixel scores
